mapper.sql: SELECT a.ID, a.ALERT_NO, a.LIMIT_ID, a.COMPANY_ID, a.ALERT_TYPE, a.ALERT_LEVEL, a.ALERT_CONTENT, a.ALERT_DATE, a.TRIGGER_CONDITIONS, a.SUGGESTED_ACTIONS, a.ALERT_STATUS, a.HANDLER_ID, a.HANDLE_TIME, a.HANDLE_COMMENTS, a.ORGID, a.CREATETIME, c.COMPANY_NAME, l.LIMIT_CODE, h.STAFF_NAME as HANDLER_NAME, u.STAFF_NAME as CREATE_USER_NAME FROM TBL_CREDIT_MONITORING_ALERT a LEFT JOIN TBL_COMPANY c ON a.COMPANY_ID = c.COMPANY_ID LEFT JOIN TBL_CREDIT_LIMIT l ON a.LIMIT_ID = l.ID LEFT JOIN TBL_STAFF h ON a.HANDLER_ID = h.STAFF_ID LEFT JOIN TBL_STAFF u ON a.CREATEUSER = u.STAFF_ID
mapper.select: WHERE a.ALERT_NO = #{alertNo} AND a.ORGID = #{orgId}
WHERE a.LIMIT_ID = #{limitId} AND a.ORGID = #{orgId} ORDER BY a.ALERT_DATE DESC, a.CREATETIME DESC
WHERE a.COMPANY_ID = #{companyId} AND a.ORGID = #{orgId} ORDER BY a.ALERT_DATE DESC, a.CREATETIME DESC
WHERE a.ALERT_TYPE = #{alertType} AND a.ORGID = #{orgId} ORDER BY a.ALERT_DATE DESC, a.CREATETIME DESC
WHERE a.ALERT_LEVEL = #{alertLevel} AND a.ORGID = #{orgId} ORDER BY a.ALERT_DATE DESC, a.CREATETIME DESC
WHERE a.ALERT_STATUS = #{alertStatus} AND a.ORGID = #{orgId} ORDER BY a.ALERT_DATE DESC, a.CREATETIME DESC
WHERE a.HANDLER_ID = #{handlerId} AND a.ORGID = #{orgId} ORDER BY a.ALERT_DATE DESC, a.CREATETIME DESC
WHERE a.ALERT_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND a.ORGID = #{orgId} ORDER BY a.ALERT_LEVEL DESC, a.ALERT_DATE DESC
WHERE a.ALERT_LEVEL IN ('HIGH', 'CRITICAL') AND a.ORGID = #{orgId} ORDER BY a.ALERT_LEVEL DESC, a.ALERT_DATE DESC
WHERE a.ALERT_LEVEL = 'CRITICAL' AND a.ORGID = #{orgId} ORDER BY a.ALERT_DATE DESC, a.CREATETIME DESC
WHERE a.ALERT_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND a.ALERT_DATE <= DATEADD(DAY, -#{days}, GETDATE()) AND a.ORGID = #{orgId} ORDER BY a.ALERT_DATE ASC
WHERE a.ALERT_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND a.HANDLER_ID IS NULL AND a.ORGID = #{orgId} ORDER BY a.ALERT_LEVEL DESC, a.ALERT_DATE DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) as totalCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN ALERT_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' THEN 1 END) as activeCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN ALERT_STATUS = 'HANDLED' THEN 1 END) as handledCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN ALERT_STATUS = 'CLOSED' THEN 1 END) as closedCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN ALERT_LEVEL = 'CRITICAL' THEN 1 END) as criticalCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN ALERT_LEVEL = 'HIGH' THEN 1 END) as highCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN ALERT_LEVEL = 'MEDIUM' THEN 1 END) as mediumCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN ALERT_LEVEL = 'LOW' THEN 1 END) as lowCount FROM TBL_CREDIT_MONITORING_ALERT WHERE ORGID = #{orgId}

SELECT ALERT_TYPE as alertType, COUNT(*) as count, COUNT(CASE WHEN ALERT_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' THEN 1 END) as activeCount FROM TBL_CREDIT_MONITORING_ALERT WHERE ORGID = #{orgId} GROUP BY ALERT_TYPE ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT ALERT_LEVEL as alertLevel, COUNT(*) as count, COUNT(CASE WHEN ALERT_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' THEN 1 END) as activeCount FROM TBL_CREDIT_MONITORING_ALERT WHERE ORGID = #{orgId} GROUP BY ALERT_LEVEL ORDER BY CASE ALERT_LEVEL WHEN 'CRITICAL' THEN 1 WHEN 'HIGH' THEN 2 WHEN 'MEDIUM' THEN 3 WHEN 'LOW' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END
SELECT ALERT_STATUS as alertStatus, COUNT(*) as count FROM TBL_CREDIT_MONITORING_ALERT WHERE ORGID = #{orgId} GROUP BY ALERT_STATUS ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT ALERT_DATE as alertDate, COUNT(*) as count, COUNT(CASE WHEN ALERT_LEVEL = 'CRITICAL' THEN 1 END) as criticalCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN ALERT_LEVEL = 'HIGH' THEN 1 END) as highCount FROM TBL_CREDIT_MONITORING_ALERT WHERE ALERT_DATE BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND ORGID = #{orgId} GROUP BY ALERT_DATE ORDER BY ALERT_DATE

SELECT h.STAFF_NAME as handlerName, COUNT(*) as totalHandled, AVG(DATEDIFF(HOUR, a.CREATETIME, a.HANDLE_TIME)) as avgHandleHours, COUNT(CASE WHEN a.ALERT_LEVEL = 'CRITICAL' THEN 1 END) as criticalHandled FROM TBL_CREDIT_MONITORING_ALERT a LEFT JOIN TBL_STAFF h ON a.HANDLER_ID = h.STAFF_ID WHERE a.ALERT_STATUS IN ('HANDLED', 'CLOSED') AND a.HANDLE_TIME IS NOT NULL AND a.ORGID = #{orgId} GROUP BY h.STAFF_NAME ORDER BY totalHandled DESC

SELECT ALERT_TYPE as alertType, COUNT(*) as totalAlerts, COUNT(CASE WHEN ALERT_STATUS = 'HANDLED' THEN 1 END) as handledAlerts, ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN ALERT_STATUS = 'HANDLED' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) as handleRate FROM TBL_CREDIT_MONITORING_ALERT WHERE ORGID = #{orgId} GROUP BY ALERT_TYPE ORDER BY handleRate DESC
mapper.update:
UPDATE TBL_CREDIT_MONITORING_ALERT SET ALERT_STATUS = #{alertStatus}, HANDLER_ID = #{handlerId}, HANDLE_TIME = GETDATE(), HANDLE_COMMENTS = #{handleComments} WHERE ID IN
#{id}
mapper.select: WHERE a.ALERT_STATUS = 'HANDLED' AND a.HANDLE_TIME <= DATEADD(DAY, -#{days}, GETDATE()) AND a.ORGID = #{orgId} ORDER BY a.HANDLE_TIME ASC

SELECT 'USAGE_RATIO' as alertType, '使用率预警' as alertTypeName, '80' as warningThreshold, '90' as criticalThreshold UNION ALL SELECT 'EXPIRY' as alertType, '到期预警' as alertTypeName, '30' as warningThreshold, '7' as criticalThreshold UNION ALL SELECT 'OVERDUE' as alertType, '逾期预警' as alertTypeName, '1' as warningThreshold, '7' as criticalThreshold UNION ALL SELECT 'RISK' as alertType, '风险预警' as alertTypeName, 'MEDIUM' as warningThreshold, 'HIGH' as criticalThreshold

SELECT ALERT_TYPE as alertType, '预警内容模板' as contentTemplate, '触发条件模板' as conditionTemplate, '建议措施模板' as actionTemplate FROM ( SELECT 'USAGE_RATIO' as ALERT_TYPE UNION ALL SELECT 'EXPIRY' UNION ALL SELECT 'OVERDUE' UNION ALL SELECT 'RISK' ) t
WHERE ALERT_TYPE = #{alertType}

SELECT s.STAFF_ID as staffId, s.STAFF_NAME as staffName, s.EMAIL as email, s.MOBILE as mobile, r.ROLE_NAME as roleName FROM TBL_STAFF s LEFT JOIN TBL_STAFF_ROLE sr ON s.STAFF_ID = sr.STAFF_ID LEFT JOIN TBL_ROLE r ON sr.ROLE_ID = r.ROLE_ID WHERE s.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND r.ROLE_CODE IN ('CREDIT_MANAGER', 'RISK_MANAGER', 'FINANCE_MANAGER') AND s.ORGID = #{orgId} ORDER BY r.ROLE_CODE, s.STAFF_NAME
